correctness.rationale: The zonal projective multiplier formula gives \(\phi_1(x)=(1+3x)/4\) and \(\phi_2(x)=(5x^2+2x-1)/6\). If \(|\phi_1(x)|\le1/8\), then \(x\in[-1/2,-1/6]\); on this interval \(\phi_2(x)+1/8=(5/6)(x+1/2)(x-1/10)\le0\), with equality only at \(x=-1/2\). Exact Legendre recurrence gives degree-three-through-nine multipliers strictly below \(1/8\) in magnitude, and the all-degree bound \(|P_n(t)|\le1\) yields \(4/[3(n+1)]<1/8\) for all \(n\ge10\). Equality degrees have dimensions 8 and 27; every positive integer power has optimal norm \(8^{-k}\). A standalone checker passed 280 exact assertions; the infinite proof is analytic.
